value: Ikusugi! M Lesson / Gone Too Far! Masochistic Lesson
Femdom visual novel with miniguy dream sequences

Starting work as a personal tutor, you are introduced to Nana and her mother Mizue, while also starting a relationship with your childhood crush Maki. As time goes on, close encounters with each of them awaken a masochistic side to your character, leading you down a path of depravity.
